stdout: agent-peek
Visibility and coordination for local AI agent sessions, and the skills they load.
Sessions:
peek list                         show active sessions (NAME is the selector for peek at)
peek at <selector> --mode brief   read one session without touching it
peek at <selector> --mode handoff --out h.md
document a new session can start from; runs the
installed agent CLI for up to a minute, --local skips it
peek ui                           browse sessions interactively
Coordination:
peek coord . --writing            see active writers in this repo
peek check <file>                 exit 1 if another agent is writing it
peek claim <file> --ttl 2m        broadcast temporary write intent
peek release <claim-id> --claim-id
Skills:
peek usage                        which skills you actually invoke
peek skills                       inventory, cost, and what is safe to archive
peek skills --interactive         browse and mark skills for archiving
peek agents                       agents peek knows, and what it can observe
Diagnostics:
peek doctor                       diagnose adapter availability
peek version                      show installed version
peek update                       install the latest npm version globally
For agents:
agent-peek-mcp                    the same as an MCP stdio server (peek_session, coordination_digest, read_feed)
--json                            machine-readable output everywhere, errors included
raw mode hides tool-only messages; pass --tools to see them
Words:
status (list)     how recently the transcript changed: active, idle, ended
activity (at)     what the agent is doing now: tool-running, thinking, idle
Exit codes:
0 ok   1 conflict or internal error   2 not found   3 ambiguous selector
4 adapter or skill error   5 usage: bad command, option, mode, or cursor
6 environment: peek cannot write ~/.agent-peek, or the registry lock is held (retry)
Focused help:
peek help coord
peek help check
peek help update
Full options:
peek <command> --help
